<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fa" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#050914">
  <title>NEXOR SHOP | مرجع رسمی</title>
  <style>
    :root{
      --bg:#050914; --panel:rgba(10,20,42,.78); --line:rgba(42,139,255,.28);
      --blue:#168cff; --cyan:#43d8ff; --text:#f3f7ff; --muted:#9eacc7;
    }
    *{box-sizing:border-box}
    body{
      margin:0; min-height:100vh; color:var(--text);
      font-family:Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,rgba(0,105,255,.22),transparent 48%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 80%,rgba(0,55,180,.15),transparent 40%),
        var(--bg);
      display:flex; justify-content:center; padding:28px 14px 40px;
    }
    .page{width:min(100%,760px)}
    .hero{
      position:relative; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius:26px; background:#050b1b; box-shadow:0 0 45px rgba(0,105,255,.18);
    }
    .hero:after{
      content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 55%,rgba(2,7,20,.55));
    }
    .hero img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;object-fit:cover}
    .brand{
      text-align:center; padding:25px 14px 18px;
    }
    .brand h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(27px,6vw,43px);letter-spacing:2px;color:#eaf6ff;text-shadow:0 0 18px #087dff}
    .verified{
      display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-top:11px;
      color:#b9dcff;font-size:13px;font-weight:bold;
      border:1px solid rgba(22,140,255,.42);background:rgba(10,70,150,.18);
      border-radius:30px;padding:7px 13px;
    }
    .tick{
      display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:19px;height:19px;border-radius:50%;
      background:#168cff;color:white;font-size:13px;font-weight:bold;
      box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(22,140,255,.65)
    }
    .intro{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:2;margin:10px auto 0;max-width:520px}
    .section-title{font-size:15px;color:#d9ecff;margin:24px 3px 12px;font-weight:bold}
    .links{display:grid;gap:12px}
    .item{
      display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;padding:16px;
      background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:17px;
      text-decoration:none;color:var(--text);transition:.2s;
      box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.14);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
    }
    a.item:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:rgba(67,216,255,.7);box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(0,119,255,.16)}
    .icon{
      flex:0 0 43px;width:43px;height:43px;border-radius:13px;display:grid;place-items:center;
      color:#dff5ff;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(0,137,255,.28),rgba(0,48,125,.24));
      border:1px solid rgba(54,164,255,.35);font-size:20px
    }
    .details{min-width:0;flex:1}
    .details strong{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .details small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;direction:rtl}
    .handle{color:#7fcaff;font-size:12px;direction:ltr;display:inline-block}
    .arrow{color:#5bbcff;font-size:20px}
    .soon{opacity:.72;cursor:default}
    .hours{
      margin-top:19px;padding:17px;border-radius:17px;text-align:center;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,91,200,.2),rgba(7,20,45,.8));
      border:1px solid rgba(50,156,255,.35)
    }
    .hours b{display:block;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px}
    .hours span{color:#8fd5ff;font-size:19px;font-weight:bold;direction:ltr;display:inline-block}
    .hours small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin-top:7px}
    footer{text-align:center;color:#7285a8;font-size:11px;line-height:2;margin-top:22px}
    .footer-brand{color:#9ddaff;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:bold}
    @media(min-width:650px){.links{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.item:first-child{grid-column:1/-1}}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main class="page">
    <div class="hero">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
